question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I can’t fit this teddy bear in my almirah. It is so ______.
solution:
The correct answer is: **gigantic**.

• The sentence mentions that the speaker cannot fit a teddy bear in their almirah, which implies that the teddy bear is too big.
